name: pont-claude-code
description: Let your Claude chat hand work to Claude Code on your computer, follow it, answer its questions and get the result back. No more copy-paste.
long_description:
Pont Claude Code connects a conversation in the Claude desktop app to Claude Code on the same computer.

The chat writes the brief, starts Claude Code in the project folder, follows its progress, answers Claude Code's questions itself whenever the answer is already in the conversation, and only interrupts you at the end, or when it needs information that only you have.

If Claude Code stops on a usage limit, the task waits and resumes by itself after the reset. While work is going on, the Mac is kept awake (caffeinate).

Requires Claude Code to be installed and signed in on this computer (`claude` command).

tools.name: cc_start
tools.description: Start Claude Code in a project folder with a full brief.

tools.name: cc_wait
tools.description: Follow a task: progress, then the report, questions or blocked actions. until_done waits for the end (comes back with "running" after the safety limit, 70 s by default). A task stopped by a usage limit shows status waiting_limit and resume_at: it resumes by itself.

tools.name: cc_reply
tools.description: Answer Claude Code or give the next step, in the same session (until_done to wait for the end).

tools.name: cc_stop
tools.description: Interrupt a task and what it launched, or cancel its automatic resume (the session is kept).

tools.name: cc_list
tools.description: Recent tasks (kept across restarts; tasks waiting for a usage limit show resume_at) and the bridge's setup.

default_cwd.title: Default project folder
default_cwd.description: Folder where Claude Code works when the chat doesn't name one.

permission_mode.title: Permission mode
permission_mode.description: What Claude Code may do on its own: acceptEdits (edit files; other actions are blocked and the chat asks you), auto (Claude Code judges what is safe), manual (nothing without approval), dontAsk (only the extra allowed tools), plan (read and plan only).

allowed_tools.title: Extra allowed tools
allowed_tools.description: Optional, comma-separated, e.g. Bash(npm:*),Bash(git:*),Bash(node:*) to let Claude Code run those commands without approval.

allow_bypass.title: Allow bypassPermissions
allow_bypass.description: Let the chat run Claude Code with no permission checks at all. Off by default: leave it off unless you work in a folder where nothing can go wrong.

until_done_safety_seconds.title: until_done safety limit (seconds)
until_done_safety_seconds.description: A cc_wait / cc_reply with until_done comes back by itself after this many seconds with status "running" (the task goes on), before remote sessions cut the call at about 80 s. 0 = no limit (wait up to max_minutes).

auto_resume.title: Reprendre automatiquement après la limite d'usage
auto_resume.description: When Claude Code stops on a usage limit ("You've hit your 5-hour limit · resets 3:10am"), the task waits (status waiting_limit) and the same session is resumed by itself 2 minutes after the reset, in the same permission mode, at most 6 times per task. If the reset time can't be read, it tries again every 30 minutes.

auto_resume_message.title: Automatic resume message
auto_resume_message.description: Message sent to Claude Code when it is resumed after a usage limit.
auto_resume_message.default: Ta limite d'usage est levée. Reprends exactement là où tu t'es arrêté, sans refaire ce qui est déjà fait. Les consignes, le feu vert et le compte rendu demandés au départ restent valables. FIN DU MESSAGE

keep_awake.title: Keep the Mac awake while working
keep_awake.description: macOS: runs caffeinate -i while a task runs or waits for its usage limit, and stops it when nothing is left. With the lid closed on battery, macOS sleeps anyway: leave the Mac open or plugged in.

model.title: Model (optional)
model.description: Model for Claude Code, e.g. opus or sonnet. Empty = your Claude Code default.

claude_bin.title: Path to claude (optional)
claude_bin.description: Only if the extension can't find Claude Code, e.g. /Users/you/.local/bin/claude.
